(24x7) shift. Responsibilities:

Disney Cruise Line – This role is on the Disney Cruise Line team, which delivers shipboard Guest and Crew systems, commercial platforms, web and app experiences, and infrastructure operations that support seamless journeys at sea.

The Role
The Lead Network Engineer on the Disney Cruise Line (DCL) New Build Technology team provides technical leadership and full stack architectural oversight for the design, integration, and delivery of onboard infrastructure environments across new vessels and staging facilities. This role owns end-to-end infrastructure delivery including compute, storage, virtualization platforms, and network systems, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned to enterprise standards.

The Lead Engineer drives build-phase execution partnering closely with Infrastructure Operations, including system integration, validation, and readiness for ship delivery, while embedding cybersecurity-by-design principles in alignment with IACS E26/E27 requirements. Acting as the technical authority, this role guides engineering decisions, resolves complex issues impacting delivery timelines, and provides oversight to vendors and cross-functional teams. This position partners closely with Infrastructure Operations, shipboard technology teams, and broader engineering organizations to ensure a seamless transition from build to steady-state operations, with a strong focus on standardization, resilience, and long-term maintainability across the fleet.

Responsibilities
• Provides technical leadership and architectural direction to systems and network engineers. Mentors junior engineers and drives technical decision-making across the build lifecycle

• Leads end-to-end infrastructure design and delivery for new ship environments, including compute, storage, virtualization, and network platforms

• Leads complex problem resolution during the build phase, performing root cause analysis for critical issues impacting delivery timelines and system readiness

• Drives the implementation of infrastructure platforms, including virtualization clusters, HCI/CI systems, SAN fabrics, and core network architecture

• Defines, enforces, and evolves technical standards and reference architectures to ensure consistency, scalability, and compliance across all new builds

• Leads cybersecurity-by-design for all infrastructure, ensuring compliance with IACS E26/E27 through embedded standards for segmentation, hardening, access control, and secure OT/IT integration across ship systems

• Develops and implements automated, repeatable deployment frameworks to enable efficient and consistent infrastructure delivery across vessels

• Partners with cross-functional engineering and operations teams to ensure seamless transition from build to steady-state operations, including documentation, knowledge transfer, and operational readiness

• Leads vendor engagement and technical oversight for hardware, software, and integration partners throughout the build lifecycle

• Ensures all infrastructure solutions align with Disney GIS security standards, including hardening, segmentation, and compliance requirements

• Drives build-phase infrastructure readiness, including system validation, performance verification, and integration across dependent platforms

• Coordinates major build milestones and infrastructure cutovers, ensuring minimal disruption and alignment with ship delivery schedules

• Guides troubleshooting strategy and escalation management, focusing on rapid resolution of blockers impacting project delivery

• Provides expert consultation to project leadership and stakeholders, influencing strategic direction and technical approach for new ship builds

Required Qualifications
• 7+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, with strong focus on network and systems architecture and large-scale deployments

• Proven expertise in enterprise network design and architecture, including routing, switching, security, and segmentation

• Experience designing and implementing software-defined networking / SD-WAN solutions

• Strong background in end-to-end infrastructure delivery, including compute, virtualization (e.g., VMware/HCI), and SAN

• Experience with enterprise networking platforms (switches, routers, firewalls, wireless) and associated management systems

• Experience developing standardized, automated deployment frameworks for infrastructure build and delivery

• Working knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and compliance standards, including IACS E26/E27, with focus on segmentation and secure architecture.

• Proven ability to lead technical decisions, mentor engineers, and drive delivery outcomes in complex projects

• Experience collaborating with vendors and cross-functional teams to deliver integrated infrastructure solutions

• Cisco CCNP (or higher) in Enterprise or Security

Preferred Qualifications
• Advanced expertise in enterprise infrastructure platforms, including Cisco UCS, Cisco ISE, VMware (including NSX/AVI Load Balancing), and Palo Alto firewalls, with focus on architecture, integration, and large-scale deployment design.

• Deep knowledge of advanced network design principles, including Quality of Service (QoS), multicast, and segmentation strategies across complex IT/OT environments.

• Experience designing and implementing identity-based network access (802.1X) across wired and wireless environments using Cisco ISE, including policy design, scalability, and operational transition models.

• Experience designing and integrating maritime satellite communication systems (VSAT/LEO/GEO) within shipboard network architectures, including optimization for latency, bandwidth constraints, link failover, and seamless transition between satellite and shore connectivity.

• Demonstrated ability to design highly resilient, fault-tolerant network architectures, including high availability, redundancy, and failure domain isolation across large-scale distributed systems.

Required Education
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience

This position is onsite and requires candidates to be in office a minimum of 3 days per week. Preferred candidates will be based in Maynard, MA.

Meet the Team
Acacia (part of Cisco) is a well-known market leader in high-speed coherent optical transceivers, pioneering the development of coherent pluggable transceivers. Acacia’s coherent products are deployed by all hyperscalers to connect their Data Centers over distances from a few kilometers to thousands of kilometers and even in submarine networks. The emergence of AI has drastically increased the demand for Acacia’s coherent transceivers, and our team is focused on the exciting challenge to architect, build, and maintain test automation software using scalable and maintainable methods.

Your Impact
We are looking for a motivated and skilled Network Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will support the deployment, maintenance, optimization, and troubleshooting of enterprise network infrastructure across multiple US and international sites. Working closely with senior engineers, you'll contribute to network reliability, security, and scalability in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Your expertise in modern infrastructure, including software-defined networking, virtualized environments, and enterprise storage will be critical in supporting Acacia’s mission to deliver industry-leading solutions that drive the digital world forward. You will be empowered to solve complex problems, contribute to architecture decisions, and help elevate the overall technology stack to meet current and future business needs Key Responsibilities include:
• Routing & Switching: Configure, deploy, and troubleshoot Cisco Catalyst and Nexus switches and enterprise routers. Support OSPF, BGP, VLAN segmentation, 802.1Q trunking, and interVLAN routing while enforcing Layer 2/3 best practices.

• Firewall Administration: Maintain and optimize security policies, NAT rules, VPN tunnels, and ACLs on Cisco ASA and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) firewalls. Configure and troubleshoot 802.1X authentication with RADIUS integration.

• SD-WAN & Management Platforms: Monitor and configure Cisco SD-WAN (Viptela/Meraki) infrastructure, assist with Cisco ISE operations and Catalyst Center/DNA Center, and support DUO MFA for secure remote access.

• Network Monitoring & Issue Resolution: Use tools like SolarWinds, PRTG, and Cisco Catalyst Center to proactively monitor network health. Serve as an escalation point for complex helpdesk issues and participate in on-call rotation for after-hours incident response.

• Network Documentation & IPAM: Uset tools like NetBox as the source of truth for network documentation, including IP address management (IPAM), device inventory, rack diagrams, and circuit tracking. Ensure records are kept accurate and up to date as the network evolves.

• Documentation & Collaboration: Maintain accurate network diagrams, IP schemas, configuration backups, SOPs, and change management records. Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and ISPs on projects and upgrades.

Travel: Willingness to travel domestically and internationally for installations, hardware deployments, and on-site troubleshooting as needed.

On Call: Candidates will be on call a minimum of two weeks per quarter.

Candidates must have the ability to lift, carry, and maneuver equipment, which involves physically mounting routers, servers and switches into data center racks.

Minimum Qualifications
• 3+ years of professional experience in network engineering or IT infrastructure

• Demonstrated experience with Cisco IOS and NX-OS CLI

• Demonstrated experience with OSI model, TCP/IP, subnetting, DNS/DHCP, VLANs, OSPF, and BGP

• Demonstrated experience with IPAM, asset management, and network documentation tools and software.

• Demonstrated experience with network monitoring platforms (SolarWinds, PRTG) and troubleshooting tools (Wireshark, ping, traceroute)

Preferred Qualifications
• Familiarity with firewall ACLs, NAT, VPNs, and 802.1X/RADIUS authentication

• Familiarity with Cisco ISE, Catalyst Center/DNA Center, Meraki SD-WAN, Cisco ASA/FTD, and DUO MFA

• Active CCNA or CCNP Enterprise certification (or equivalent vendor-neutral certification)

• Exposure to cloud networking environments such as AWS VPC or Azure Virtual Network, including hybrid cloud connectivity

• Familiarity with network automation and scripting tools such as Python or Ansible for routine task automation

• Experience working in regulated industries such as healthcare, finance, or government, with an emphasis on compliance and security best practices

• Experience with NetBox, including custom fields, webhooks, and API integrations for network automation workflows

• Hands-on experience with VMware virtualization platforms (vSphere, vCenter, NSX-T), including virtual networking concepts such as distributed virtual switches (DVS), port groups, and VM network connectivity

• Familiarity with enterprise storage solutions (SAN, NAS, or hyper-converged infrastructure) and their integration with network infrastructure, including protocols such as iSCSI, NFS, or Fiber Channel Cisco Confidential

• Hands-on experience with additional SD-WAN platforms or next-generation firewall technologies beyond the Cisco ecosystem

• Familiarity with DevOps or Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) practices as they relate to network provisioning and configuration management

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

Why Cisco?
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Position Overview:

The Command, Control, Battle Management, and Communications (C2BMC) program is a vital part of the Missile Defense System. C2BMC supports layered missile defense systems that deliver an optimized response to threats across all ranges and flight phases. It functions as a force multiplier by connecting, integrating, and synchronizing autonomous sensors, weapon systems, and operations at both global and regional levels to improve performance. C2BMC is crucial for all grounds and flight tests that verify and demonstrate the current and future capabilities of missile defense systems.

We are looking for a skilled and highly motivated Principal Network Engineer to join our team supporting the C2BMC X-Lab Test Program.
